from io import StringIO

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("svg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from js import document

x = list(range(11))
y = [value ** 2 for value in x]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 3.5))
ax.plot(x, y, marker="o", color="#2563eb")
ax.set(title="Quadratic sequence", xlabel="x", ylabel="x²")
ax.grid(alpha=0.25)
fig.tight_layout()

buffer = StringIO()
fig.savefig(buffer, format="svg")
document.getElementById("plot").innerHTML = buffer.getvalue()
plt.close(fig)
